companyIntro.name: Landmark Realty Partners
companyIntro.mission: Invest in and manage property with discipline on income, risk and tenants.
companyIntro.culture: Underwrite conservatively, collect rent on time, fix what matters first.

projectBackground.name: Office Portfolio Acquisition — Harbour Tower
projectBackground.context: The committee wants a view on whether the asking price is justified by income and whether the loan is safe.

manager.name: Daniel Reeves
manager.role: Head of Acquisitions, Landmark Realty Partners
manager.note: Price the income, not the story. Show NOI, yield and debt cover.

assignment.title: Underwrite the acquisition
assignment.brief: Calculate NOI, cap rate, value and DSCR, compare properties in Excel and write the memo.

tasks.title: Net Operating Income
tasks.prompt: Gross rent 1,200,000; 5% vacancy; operating expenses 420,000. What is NOI?
tasks.reasoning: NOI is income after vacancy and operating costs, before debt.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Cap Rate
tasks.prompt: NOI 720,000 on a price of 9,000,000. What is the cap rate (%)?
tasks.reasoning: Cap rate is the income yield on price.
tasks.mistake: Quoting cap rate on gross rent misleads.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Value at Market Cap Rate
tasks.prompt: At a market cap rate of 7.5%, what is the property's value?
tasks.mistake: A small cap rate change moves value a lot.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Debt Service Cover
tasks.prompt: NOI 720,000; annual debt service 540,000. What is DSCR?
tasks.mistake: DSCR just above the covenant is fragile.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Property Comparison (Excel)
tasks.prompt: Cap rate % in column D = NOI / price x 100.
tasks.reasoning: Property C has the highest yield; B is the lowest.
tasks.mistake: Highest yield can mean highest risk.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Investment Memo
tasks.modelAnswer: The asking price of 9,000,000 implies an 8% cap rate on a stable NOI of 720,000, and at a 7.5% market cap rate the value is about 9,600,000, so the price looks reasonable. Debt service cover of 1.33 is acceptable but thin if vacancy rises. I recommend proceeding subject to confirming lease expiries and negotiating a lower rate or longer interest-only period. A downside case with 10% vacancy should be reviewed before final approval.
tasks.reasoning: A good memo links price to income, tests risk and sets conditions.
tasks.mistake: Memos without a downside case are one-sided.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

caseStudy.title: Case Study: The Empty Tower
caseStudy.background: A buyer paid a 6% cap rate for an office on a lease expiring in a year. The tenant left, NOI halved and the loan covenant broke.
questions: How would you structure the deal?
caseStudy.solution: Landmark now models lease expiry and downtime in every underwriting.
caseStudy.lessonsLearned: Underwrite the leases, not the headline.

prompts: Which number would you stress first?
How low can DSCR go safely?
What would make you walk away?
